cooper.roteiro:
HOOK: [Pexels: man in dark suit and black tie boarding a passenger jet in 1971] Fifty-five years ago today, a man in a black tie boarded a plane.

MICRO REWARD 1: [Pexels: man in dark suit and black tie sitting in an airplane seat with a briefcase] Calling himself Dan Cooper, he demanded cash and four parachutes.

MICRO REWARD 2: [Pexels: man in dark suit wearing a parachute at the open rear door of a jet at night] That night, somewhere past Seattle, he jumped.

PAYOFF: [Pexels: old dollar bills half buried in wet river sand] Some of the cash turned up. Cooper never did.

leprince.roteiro:
HOOK: [Pexels: bearded man in 1880s suit operating a wooden box camera in a garden] In 1888, Louis Le Prince shot the oldest film that still exists.

MICRO REWARD 1: [Pexels: bearded man in a long 1890 coat boarding a steam train] Two years later, Le Prince boarded a train to Paris.

MICRO REWARD 2: [Pexels: empty vintage train compartment] The train arrived. Le Prince did not.

PAYOFF: [Pexels: bearded man in a long 1890 coat walking into steam on a station platform] No body. No luggage. Le Prince was never seen again.
leprince.ideia: Louis Le Prince, a bearded inventor in an 1880s suit, filmed the oldest surviving motion picture in 1888, boarded a train to Paris in 1890 and was never seen again.

slocum.roteiro:
HOOK: [Pexels: old bearded sailor at the helm of a small wooden sailboat] Joshua Slocum was the first man to sail around the world alone.

MICRO REWARD 1: [Pexels: old bearded sailor on a small wooden sailboat in a storm] It took Slocum three years in a small wooden boat.

MICRO REWARD 2: [Pexels: old bearded sailor raising the sail and leaving a harbor in autumn] In 1909, at sixty-five, Slocum sailed out once more.

PAYOFF: [Pexels: empty gray ocean horizon at dusk] Neither Slocum nor his boat was ever seen again.
